newsitem.title: USA: Telxon to sell unit for $65 mln.
newsitem.headline: Telxon to sell unit for $65 mln.

text.p: Telxon Corp said Monday it expects to post a pretax gain of about $35 million from the sale of its Itronix Corp unit to Dynatech Corp.
The gain is expected to be partially offset by about $25 million in charges, it said.
The company is selling Itronix for about $65 million, including repayment of intercompany loans.
The deal is expected to close by tomorrow, it said.

Telxon said it expects $25 million in charges related to staff cuts and an early retirement program, and "decreased carrying value of inventories affected by our streamlining of product lines, the consolidation of our field operations, and redesign of our worldwide distribution and logistics organization."
Telxon designs and manufactures wireless and mobile transaction solution systems. Itronix is involved in the notebook computer industry.
